verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the LaunchDarkly Relay Proxy as a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure, which keeps SDK traffic inside your network. A community user independently confirms LaunchDarkly offers an open-source Relay you run in your own environment for extra resiliency, and the Cloudflare edge SDK reference adds an edge deployment option. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of how flags keep being served during a vendor outage (e.g. persistent store or offline-mode details), and deeper documentation of Relay configuration and network-isolation setup.
